title: 第六章 我叫侯紫
slug: 凡人修仙谁说修仙必须灵力
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

猴子刚把袋子塞进怀里，手还没从衣襟里抽出来。

一队黑衣人，八个，腰间系着统一的黑色腰牌，脚步整齐得像一个人。山里好像突然安静了。

走在最前面的那个身形瘦高，腰间挂的不是刀，是一把带鞘的长剑。已经到了面前。

猴子蹲在崖壁下，手还捂在胸口。他心里咯噔一下。但他没有跑。他看到脚步的节奏、腰间的腰牌。不是王府的人。

刘管事的人走路永远是乱的，喊叫声永远比脚步声先到。这帮人走路没有声音，连呼吸都压得一样轻。这是比王府狠十倍的角色。

八个黑衣人已经走到崖壁下面。火把的蓝光把碎石坡照得惨白。瘦高个停在他五步之外，目光扫了一眼崖壁上的裂缝，又扫了一眼地上干涸的血迹，最后落在猴子身上。

“这山上的人是你杀的？”

猴子抬起头。他看了瘦高个的脸，带着一种见惯了生死的平淡。这种人在王府里见过，最难糊弄。但更难糊弄的人也见过，岳州城赌场门口的账房先生，看你一眼就知道你口袋里有多少钱。对付这种人只有一个办法：不说全实话，也不说全假话。让他觉得你是个没用但有点用处的普通人。

“大人说笑了。”猴子站起来，拍了拍膝盖上的土。“我要是能杀这么多人，还蹲在这荒山野岭里啃野果子？我就是个挖草药的，前天进山采三七，碰上山崩迷了路，躲在这崖壁底下不敢出去。”

瘦高个没说话。他身后一个黑衣人弯腰在碎石坡上翻了一下，捡起一把刀鞘，陈三的刀鞘，猴子故意搁在裂缝边缘的那把。黑衣人把刀鞘递给瘦高个。

瘦高个接过来，用手指摩挲了一下刀鞘上的磨痕。“陈三的刀。去年在岳州城门口一刀劈了三个捕快。他的刀鞘在这里，刀呢？”

猴子看了一眼那道深不见底的裂缝。“掉下去了。刚才有两个人在这里打架，打得山都晃，然后都掉下去了。我躲在石头后面，大气都不敢喘。”

“你杀的？”

“大人，您看我像能杀陈三的人吗？”猴子把胳膊伸出来，细得跟柴火棍似的。“他一根手指头就能捏死我。”

瘦高个把刀鞘扔回地上，走近了一步。火把的光照在猴子脸上，把他脸上的烂泥照得清清楚楚。脸上、脖子上、手腕上，全身上下只有两只眼睛是干净的。瘦高个看了一会儿，忽然问了一句：“你叫什么？”

猴子张了张嘴。他本来想说“猴子”。

猴子是岳州城市井里的叫法，是别人瞧不起他的叫法。是那个被人踹屁股、被人抢窝头、被人骂野种的野孩子的名字。

现在刘管事死了，王府的追兵全埋在山里了。那个叫猴子的野孩子，已经死在十万大山里了。

他想起小时候养父教他写的两个字。

他站直了身子。

“侯紫。侯爷的侯，紫微星的紫。”

Page (1/3)

Monkey had just stuffed the bag into his arms, but had not yet taken his hands out of his clothes.

There was a group of eight people in black clothes, with uniform black waistbands tied around their waists, and their steps were as neat as one person.The mountains seemed suddenly quiet.

The one walking in the front was tall and thin, and what was hanging on his waist was not a knife, but a sheathed long sword.Already in front of you.

The monkey squatted under the cliff with his hand still covering his chest.His heart skipped a beat.But he didn't run.He saw the rhythm of his footsteps and the badge on his waist.Not from the palace.

Manager Liu always walks in a chaotic manner, and the shouts always arrive before the footsteps.This group of people walked without making a sound, and even breathed just as softly.This is a character ten times more ruthless than Wang Fu.

Eight men in black have walked to the bottom of the cliff.The blue light from the torches illuminated the gravel slope palely.The tall and thin man stopped five steps away from him, and his eyes glanced at the cracks on the cliff, then at the dried blood on the ground, and finally fell on the monkey.

"Did you kill the people on this mountain?"

The monkey raised his head.He looked at the tall and thin man's face, with an expression of indifference as if he was used to life and death.I have seen this kind of person in the palace, and he is the hardest to fool.But people who are even more difficult to fool have also seen it. The cashier at the entrance of Yuezhou City Casino can tell you how much money you have in your pocket just by looking at you.There is only one way to deal with such people: neither tell the truth nor lies.Let him think you are a useless but somewhat useful ordinary person.

"Sir, you are joking." The monkey stood up and patted the soil on his knees."If I can kill so many people, why should I squat in this barren mountain and eat wild fruits? I am just a herb digger. I went into the mountains to collect Panax notoginseng the day before yesterday. I encountered a landslide and got lost. I hid under this cliff and dared not go out."

The tall and thin man said nothing.Behind him, a man in black bent over the gravel slope and picked up a scabbard, Chen San's scabbard, the one that the monkey deliberately placed on the edge of the crack.The man in black handed the scabbard to the tall and thin man.

The tall and thin man took it and rubbed the wear marks on the scabbard with his fingers."Chen San's sword. Last year he killed three policemen at the gate of Yuezhou City. His scabbard is here, where is the sword?"

The monkey glanced at the bottomless crack."It fell. There were two people fighting here just now. The fight shook the mountain, and then they both fell. I hid behind the stone and didn't dare to breathe."

"Did you kill him?"

"Sir, do you think I am someone who can kill Chen San?" The monkey stretched out his arm, as thin as a matchstick."He could crush me to death with one finger."

The tall and thin man threw the scabbard back to the ground and took a step closer.The light from the torch shone on the monkey's face, clearly illuminating the mud on his face.On the face, neck, wrists, and on the whole body, only two eyes are clean.The tall and thin man looked at it for a while and suddenly asked: "What is your name?"

The monkey opened his mouth.He originally wanted to say "monkey."

Monkey is the name of the well in Yuezhou City, and it is the name of others who look down upon him.It was the name of the wild child who was kicked in the butt, robbed of his bread, and called a bastard.

Now that Manager Liu is dead, all the palace's pursuers are buried in the mountains.That wild boy named Monkey has died in Shiwanda Mountain.

He remembered the two words his adoptive father taught him to write when he was a child.

He stood up straight.

"Hou Zi. The Hou of Lord Hou, the purple of Ziweixing."
